According to the discussions in the provided data tables and text exchanges, Merrick expresses a strong negative opinion towards Ramsay Bolton, viewing him as the most hateable character in Game of Thrones. Merrick states, "Ramsay was just on another level of twisted. I'm leaning toward Ramsay though, he was just pure evil." This sentiment is echoed by several other participants in the conversation, as they also list Ramsay among the top contenders for the most hateable character, with some explicitly stating their preference for Ramsay over characters like Joffrey Baratheon and Cersei Lannister.

Here are relevant excerpts from the discussion:

Merrick: "Ramsay for me! He was just on another level of twisted. I'm leaning toward Ramsay though, he was just pure evil."

EmilyBurnett: "I think I might have to agree with Merrick! Ramsay was just on another level of twisted. 😬"

Merrick: "Looks like Joffrey is getting a lot of hate here! I'm leaning toward Ramsay though, he was just pure evil."

Saffron: "I'm definitely going with Cersei! Her coldness and manipulation were just infuriating. But I see you're all over Ramsay from Merrick and Emily... for calling him 'pure evil,' I guess I'm in the Ramsay camp too. It's undeniable how deeply detestable his actions and personality are."

Given this dialogue, it is evident from the conversation that Merrick personally finds Ramsay Bolton to be the character with the most severe negative qualities, earning the title of "most hateable" in his perspective within the Game of Thrones fandom. This is a consensus among some participants, confirming Ramsay's role as a character the majority of users perceive as deeply reprehensible in the context of the series.
